findings.audit_finding: Development ngoài window nhưng nằm ở tương lai: calibration inputs outside the evaluation window but in the future can steer the calibration.
findings.verification: FP01-T01: future-only mutations leave the pre-evaluation profile identical; one prefix move shifts it; missing boundary and unavailable-at-decision both refuse.
findings.planned_phase: FP-03 (calibration origins) / FP-05 (labels) must pass through this guard
findings.claim_limit: No calibration input at/after the declared evaluation boundary may feed a profile; the tail rides along.

findings.audit_finding: Admission tính sau deployment: ra05_discovery.run_one_arm ran the full account first, then recorded admission as a descriptive funnel; the deep-dive ran no admission at all.
findings.required: Wire admission trước account consumes params
findings.verification: FP01-T02 on the real engine path: forced rejection of every fold yields NO_ADMITTED_DEPLOYMENT with empty equity/fills (never PnL=0); the admission-OFF control consumes the rejected params; forced admission deploys exactly the raw stock record.
findings.planned_phase: FP-07 locked study passes an admission_policy; FP-02 re-qualifies the route with the wiring on
findings.claim_limit: Runs published before this repair used the unwired path; they keep outputs, cited as invalidated_by FP-F02-wiring for any future admission claim, never edited.

findings.audit_finding: Warmup lẫn statistical window: warmup bars counted inside the statistical sample.
findings.required: Compute returns với prior equity rồi clip đúng
findings.verification: FP01-T04: 31 more warmup marks before the window leave sample count AND every reported return unchanged.
findings.planned_phase: FP-02 re-measures on the qualified route
findings.claim_limit: Warmup handling is a measured property of the boundary functions, never prose.

findings.audit_finding: D1 mất first return: ra07_decay._deployment_slice measured the first in-window return from the first IN-WINDOW mark, dropping one observation versus the IS side.
findings.verification: FP01-T03: 100->120->108 yields exactly [0.2, -0.1]; legacy reproduces exactly one; no prior mark -> explicit PRIOR_EQUITY_UNAVAILABLE, never an invented 1.0.
findings.planned_phase: FP-07 D1 uses fp/decay_bounds.windowed_returns; RA-07 rows are recomputed_from, never overwritten
findings.claim_limit: Published D1 rows keep values; any FP headline quoting them states the legacy dropped-first-return convention.

findings.audit_finding: IS/OOS sizing khác nhau: IS scoring vs forward deployment could run different economics.
findings.verification: FP01-T05 on the real engine: IS scorer vs deployment account reach rtol=1e-9 equity parity; capitals equal at 20000.
findings.claim_limit: Parity is measured per route pair/version, not a standing certificate.

findings.audit_finding: Verdict không trực tiếp so treatment: FUP-05's CADENCE_ARTIFACT came from a placebo-vs-BAND comparison, never a direct REGIME_TIMING-minus-comparator contrast.
findings.required: New claim logic dựa contrast đúng
findings.verification: Band-only refuses with the missing contrast named; direct below/above decide artifact/survived; unsigned delta is not inferred.
findings.planned_phase: FP-09 verdicts must call fp/claim_logic with the paired direct contrast
findings.claim_limit: FUP-05 CADENCE_ARTIFACT may not be cited as a causal verdict; only as the DESCRIPTIVE band observation.
invalidated_runs: evidence/corrective_mode4_v3/FUP-05/placebo_result.json (verdict field only; descriptive numbers keep values)

findings.audit_finding: LOO sử dụng future origins: time-sorted leave-one-out can train on future labels; RA-06's ladder never fit (support 5 < 8), so no guard existed anywhere.
findings.verification: FP01-T07: naive LOO rows over the same fixture both fail the guard at the held origin's decision time; a row with no availability field refuses.
findings.planned_phase: FP-05 fits go through fp/chronology; the registered MIN_SUPPORT gate stays
findings.claim_limit: No in-sample residual may be presented as generalization uncertainty (guide 8.5).

findings.audit_finding: Raw artifacts thiếu trong package: untracked run dirs and gitignored binaries referenced but not in git.
findings.required: Export existing outputs, không thay run khác
findings.verification: Inventory lists every missing/untracked artifact with a planned export action; no run is re-generated to fill a gap.
findings.planned_phase: FP-02 (export small JSON), FP-10 (freeze package with detached digests)
findings.claim_limit: A missing raw artifact caps every claim that needs it; never zero-filled, never replaced by another run.

findings.audit_finding: Gate kiểm token/field thay hành vi: a verifier reading its own prior success record instead of the behavior.
evidence_refs: src/crypto_regime_lab/fp/verifier_fp01.py (hash re-check of every artifact, pytest XML re-parse with FP01-T01..T07 presence, gate re-evaluation from artifacts)
findings.verification: Four failure shapes each proved to fail; the PASS bundle is independently re-verified.
findings.planned_phase: FP-02..FP-10 verifiers inherit this behavioral shape
findings.claim_limit: Neither the process exit code nor this verifier's PASS is evidence without the artifacts it inspected.
